name: VitaDeploy
description: Toolbox that makes homebrewing the PSVITA easier.
long_description: Installs and updates the software a modded PSVITA needs, including firmware components and common homebrew, from the device itself. A mshell build is in the same release.
requirements: Requires a jailbroken PS Vita/PSTV and installation of the VPK via VitaShell (or compatible package installer).
